faq.question: Do I need to export my PostHog data to use Beton?
faq.answer: No. Beton reads events directly from your PostHog instance via the API — PostHog Cloud or self-hosted both work. Nothing is copied or migrated. You provide connection credentials and can revoke access at any time.

faq.question: Does Beton slow down my PostHog instance?
faq.answer: No. Beton queries event batches on a schedule (typically every few minutes) rather than streaming every event, and respects PostHog's rate limits. In practice the read load is a few queries per sync interval.

faq.question: Which PostHog event types does Beton analyze?
faq.answer: Beton reads standard event types (pageviews, custom events, group events, identify calls) plus person and group properties. Heuristic detection surfaces behavioral patterns automatically — you don't need to pre-define which events matter.

faq.question: Does Beton store the raw PostHog events?
faq.answer: No. Beton reads events, computes signals, and stores only the signal output (type, confidence, events referenced). Granular product analytics data stays in PostHog.

seo.metaDescription: Connect PostHog to Beton for behavioral signal detection. Turn product analytics events into revenue signals automatically.

faq.question: What does Beton create in Attio?
faq.answer: Beton upserts Companies and People, writes custom attributes for signals (type, confidence, event list, detected timestamp), and can add entries to a list of your choice. You configure which list and which attributes in Attio's workspace settings.

faq.question: Can I map Beton signals to Attio deals or tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. Beton supports creating tasks, updating deal-stage attributes, and posting to Attio Activities via Attio's native objects. Configuration lives in each signal's destination settings.

faq.question: Does Beton overwrite existing Attio records?
faq.answer: Beton never overwrites user-entered data. It uses Attio's upsert APIs with domain or email as the matching key, appending new signal attributes without touching fields you've set manually.

faq.question: Do I need an Attio paid plan?
faq.answer: Any Attio plan that exposes the API works, including the Free plan for light usage. Heavier signal volumes may require Plus or Pro due to Attio's API call limits.

faq.question: Does Beton work with HubSpot Free?
faq.answer: HubSpot Free supports contact creation and basic property updates, which Beton uses. Deal stage updates and workflow triggers require Starter or higher. Beton gracefully falls back when a feature is unavailable on your plan.

faq.question: Can I route Beton signals to a specific HubSpot pipeline?
faq.answer: Yes. Pipeline and deal-stage routing are configured per signal type. You can also trigger HubSpot workflows directly using custom properties that Beton writes to contacts or companies.

faq.question: What data does Beton send to HubSpot?
faq.answer: Company name, domain, and signal metadata (type, confidence, events referenced, detected timestamp) — written to custom properties on Contact or Company records. Beton does not sync raw product events, only detected signals.

faq.question: Does Beton use HubSpot's OAuth or API keys?
faq.answer: OAuth. You authorize Beton in HubSpot's connected-app settings — no private API keys to manage. Revoke access at any time from HubSpot's integrations panel.

faq.question: Which Zoho editions does Beton support?
faq.answer: Beton works with all paid Zoho CRM editions that expose the REST API (Standard and above). Accounts, Contacts, Leads, and Deals modules are all supported. API limits follow Zoho's per-edition quotas.

faq.question: Can I route signals to different Zoho layouts?
faq.answer: Yes. Each Zoho layout can receive different signal types — useful for separating PLG signals from enterprise sales leads. Layout mapping is per signal type in Beton's destination settings.

faq.question: How does Beton handle Zoho's API rate limits?
faq.answer: Beton queues writes and respects Zoho's per-user and per-org limits. If a limit is hit, writes retry automatically on the next sync cycle — nothing is dropped.

faq.question: Does Beton support Zoho Blueprints?
faq.answer: Yes. Beton can trigger Zoho Blueprint transitions by writing to trigger fields you configure, letting signal detection kick off your existing Zoho automation workflows.

faq.question: Can I use Pipedrive webhooks alongside Beton signals?
faq.answer: Yes. Pipedrive's native webhooks fire after Beton writes a record, so any downstream automation you have in Pipedrive works unchanged. You can also use Beton's Webhooks integration to hit Pipedrive's API directly for custom flows.

faq.question: Does Beton support Pipedrive custom fields?
faq.answer: Yes. Beton will auto-create custom fields for signal metadata (confidence, events, detected_at) the first time it writes a record, or use existing fields if you've pre-created them in Pipedrive.

faq.question: Can I route signals to a specific Pipedrive pipeline?
faq.answer: Yes. Pipeline and stage selection are per signal type. You can isolate product-led signals in one pipeline while keeping outbound-sourced leads in another.

faq.question: What's the difference between Webhooks and the n8n integration?
faq.answer: The n8n integration is a pre-built connector with a fixed payload shape. Webhooks is the generic version — point it at any HTTPS endpoint, including your own API, Zapier, Make, Slack workflows, or a custom service.

faq.question: How are webhook payloads authenticated?
faq.answer: Beton signs every request with HMAC-SHA256 using a shared secret you configure. The signature is in the X-Beton-Signature header. Basic auth and custom headers are also supported for legacy systems.

faq.question: Can I retry failed webhook deliveries?
faq.answer: Yes. Beton retries failed deliveries with exponential backoff up to 10 attempts over 24 hours. Delivery logs are visible in the Signals dashboard so you can debug endpoint issues.

faq.question: What does the webhook payload contain?
faq.answer: A JSON object with signal_type, confidence, source, destination, account (name, domain), events, enrichment, and detected_at. A sample payload is shown on this page.

seo.metaDescription: Send revenue signals anywhere via HTTP webhooks. Build custom integrations with your existing stack using Beton's webhook support.

faq.question: How do I trigger n8n workflows from Beton signals?
faq.answer: Beton sends each signal as an HTTP POST to an n8n webhook URL you configure. Your n8n workflow then routes the payload to any destination — Slack, Salesforce, Notion, custom APIs — with full workflow logic.

faq.question: What does the n8n signal payload look like?
faq.answer: A JSON object with signal_type, confidence, account (name, domain), events, enrichment, and detected_at. You can see a sample on this page.

faq.question: Can I use Beton with self-hosted n8n?
faq.answer: Yes. As long as your n8n instance accepts HTTPS webhooks, Beton can route signals to it. The webhook URL is configured in Beton's destination settings — same flow as n8n Cloud.

faq.question: Does Beton count against my n8n execution quota?
faq.answer: Each signal received triggers one workflow execution. On n8n Cloud this counts against your monthly quota; on self-hosted there is no quota. Filter signal types at the Beton side to avoid unused executions.
